rows.abstract:

Provides golf caddies and other related service workers retirement benefits under Republic Act No. 11199, otherwise known as the “Social Security Act of 2018.”

rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE OPERATIONS AND IMPOSITION OF FEES FOR THE USE OF PARKING SPACES AND PARKING FACILITIES IN VARIOUS ESTABLISHMENTS SUCH AS TO ACCOMMODATION, COMMERCIAL SERVICES, FOOD SERVICES, HEALTH SERVICES, RETAIL SERVICES, EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS INCLUDING INDEPENDENT PARKING ENTERPRISES AND PRESCRIBING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS THEREOF
rows.title_short:
“ Parking Operations
And Fees Regulation Act ”
rows.abstract:
Seeks to prioritize public safety and welfare, as well as to protect the interest and promote the general welfare of consumers who avail of parking facilities offered by business operators from unreasonable parking rates and fees while allowing reasonable return of investment.
Rationalizes the provision of parking spaces and regulation of parking fees on all parking facilities of covered establishments for all types of vehicles such as but not limited to bicycles, motorcycles, and automobiles.
Provides prohibition on covered establishments from invoking waiver of liability in case of loss of property or damage to the customer´s or parking client´s vehicle.

rows.title_short: Government Financial Institutions Unified Initiatives ( G F Is) To Distressed Enterprises For Economic Recovery ( G U I D E ) Act
rows.abstract:
Aims to protect employment and assist distressed enterprises due to the community quarantine measures that restricted the operation of numerous businesses.
Seeks to strengthen the capacity of the Philippine Guarantee Corporation (PGC), the Land Bank of the Philippines (LBP), and the Development Bank of the Philippines (DBP) in order to provide the needed assistance to micro, small, and medium enterprises (SMSEs), and other strategically important companies.
Grants LBP and DBP to create a special holding company (SHC) which aims to further reinvigorate important companies heavily affected by the COVID-19 pandemic.
Provides incentives and exemptions privileges to the DBP, LBP and the SHC.

AN ACT INSTITUTING POLICIES FOR THE PROTECTION AND PROMOTION OF THE WELFARE OF WORKERS OR INDEPENDENT CONTRACTORS IN THE FILM, TELEVISION, AND RADIO
ENTERTAINMENT INDUSTRY
rows.title_short: " Eddie Garcia Act "
rows.abstract:
Aims to ensure safety and to establish emergency protocols while artists are at work. 
Sets standards and specifies working hours required of artists based on age, as well as prescribes provision of accident and medical insurance for all workers, both on-screen or off-screen, involved and employed in the covered industries.
Mandates the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) to initiate the creation of the Film, Television, and Radio Entertainment Industry Tripartite Council that shall serve as a link among various stakeholders concerning labor issues and provide the film, television, and radio entertainment industry with a platform for the employers or principals and workers or independent contractors to represent their respective groups on the crafting of policy decisions, and serve as an avenue to express their aspirations, present their programs or bridge gaps in cases of conflict among them, subject to the accreditation of the DOLE.

rows.title_short: " Green Measures Act "
rows.abstract:
Mandates all applicants for building permits of residential, commercial, industrial and public building development projects to submit a Tree Planting Plan (TPP) in additional to other requirements imposed by local government units.
Encourages the planting of indigenous species of trees, taking into account the location, climate and topography of the area.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING PROTECTION TO FREELANCERS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
\" Freelancers Protection Act \"
Intends to recognize the changing landscape of how jobs are performed by freelancers whether in-person or through online platforms or gig economy, which has grown exponentially with technological advancement, and to address their weakening labor rights and their changing concepts of work and employer-employee relationship. Provides therefore a regulatory framework for their unique circumstances by putting their safety and welfare into consideration, among others. Seeks to cover all freelancers, regardless of the profession, talent, skills, task, work or service required to be rendered. Defines several terms among others such as crowdwork, platform provider and other related terms.

rows.author: H092
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE OVERSEAS FILIPINO WORKERS (OFW) SOVEREIGN FUND
rows.title_short: \" O F W  Sovereign Fund Act \"
rows.abstract:
Directs the Bureau of Treasury (BTr) to create a sperate special fund to be referred to as the OFW Sovereign Fund, where all investments made under the program shall be lodged until it is utilized by the government for its select key projects.

Provides income tax and documentary stamp tax exemption on the earnings of OFWs and former OFWs from their investment in the bonds or other debt or investment instruments that the government shall issue in the implementation of this Act.
